notes:
Original p. 7 corresponds to printed p. 212. Replication locator p. 15 selects the exploratory test excluding agreement with either initial request. The preregistered combined-controls test on p. 14 instead prints χ² = 10.82, p = .001 with whole-study analytic N = 391; it is a different sample/test and is not merged with the p. 15 result. Exploratory analytic n is left null rather than calculated.
Completion source review (n_o): Final Table 3 groups are explicitly randomized, mutually exclusive conditions used in this named contrast. Three mutually exclusive conditions, 24 participants each; controls pooled for the contrast. No exclusions from these final counts are stated.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Requested test statistic is printed for this explicitly named planned comparison; chi-square symbol is OCR-corrupted in canonical text.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Exact p = .091 is printed for the same rejection-moderation versus combined-controls test.
